entries.title: Odd Realm

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Odd Realm reached 1.0 on August 16, 2024 and is a sandbox colony simulation developed by Unknown Origin Games. Windows, macOS, and Linux/SteamOS are supported. No sourced console or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the main capture route while the other native desktop builds are valid alternatives.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for the main archive route. Use macOS or Linux only as native convenience alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched 1.0 build.
